data.title: 姬柊雪菜 · 公寓玄关的便当递出微笑
data.description: 清晨公寓玄关处，朝阳洒在整齐的木地板上。雪菜身穿柔软的米色针织衫，外系着可爱的碎花小围裙。黑发在脑后扎成俏丽的马尾，双手恭恭敬敬地递来包好的双层便当盒。脸颊泛着淡淡的红晕，她认真地叮嘱前辈中午一定要全部吃完，满脸初为人妻的羞赧与幸福。
data.action: standing in apartment entryway holding wrapped bento box with both hands, floral apron over knit sweater, hair in ponytail, earnest sweet blushing smile looking at viewer
data.location: tidy sunlit Japanese apartment genkan entryway with wooden shoe cabinet
data.lighting: fresh clear morning daylight pouring through glass front door
data.mood: sweet devoted domesticity, classic wifely affection
data.promptProse: Standing in a sunlit apartment entryway, Yukina holds forward a carefully wrapped bento box with both hands. Wearing a cute apron over a soft sweater, she smiles with earnest, wifely affection.
data.animaCaption: Holding out a carefully wrapped bento box in a cute knit apron, she smiles sweetly in the morning sun.
